tactics.name: Discovery
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to figure out your environment.

techniques.name: System Information Discovery
techniques.description: An adversary may attempt to get detailed information about the operating system and hardware, Windows API calls, network configuration and settings.

techniques.name: Process Discovery
techniques.description: An adversary may attempt to get information about running processes on a system.

tactics.name: Execution
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to run malicious code.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
techniques.description: An adversary may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands, scripts, or binaries.
